claim: mosquitto(8)'s $SYS/broker/mqtt/* topic listing (e.g. $SYS/broker/mqtt/publish/dropped, $SYS/broker/mqtt/connect/received) is wrong as of 2.1.2: sys_tree.c never publishes those topics ('Not published in $SYS, may be made available for plugins'), so a $SYS monitoring agent must use $SYS/broker/publish/messages/dropped and the load tree, not the mqtt/* variants.
stance_target: Any implementation (or draft recommendation) that reads $SYS/broker/mqtt/* counters — including the mqtt/publish/dropped alias shown in the current man page
quoted_support: These are never published, as of version 2.1.2. In sys_tree.c, these topics are excluded explicitly from being published. The associated commit states 'Not published in $SYS, may be made available for plugins.'
